title: Export a recorded run fixture from an embedded cyclotron, with consent and redaction
description:
The marketing site shows only recorded results (decision-flywheel-a5b184fd). Add an export from subscribe() history to the editorial-run-v1 fixture shape used by Cyclotron-web (components/fixtures): per cycle the item title, decision, confidence, probabilities, version, review reason, label, reason code, explanation, plus promotion events with their proposals. Add source (for example papyrus-live) and a disclosure that labels are real reviews. Explanations are kept only when the review is marked shareable; others are redacted. Ordering: after the SDK facade and the review-rate program.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exporting a fake-model run produces a fixture that Cyclotron-web's existing pictogram loaders accept.
- Non-shareable explanations and any configured private fields are absent from the file.
- The fixture records cyclotron versions so a page can show one review leading to one promoted version.,

comments.author: home
comments.text: Engine part for Papyrus's recording on feat/sdk-usage: the SDK now records model usage per decision (paid shared decision-model requests from decide and from learning during a review; optimizer calls from their optimizer-response events), Cyclotron.usage(prices, window) returns the run_usage.usage_by_window shape per window of decisions, and Cyclotron.decision_log() lists decisions in order with their active reviews. Specs: embedded_usage_test.py (3) and a docs sample. Papyrus builds the editorial-run fixture from these (PPY-54957abe). Gap noted: a paid request that fails is counted by SharedDecisions' attempt ceiling but reports no usage.
